notes: v147: project summary stat cards and project status filters are adaptive by screen width to avoid overflow. Small screens fit 2/3 columns; larger screens fit 3/4 columns.
V151 uses thin squircle date labels for D/A/M and renders the same in Admin Mobile UI Designer and employee APK.
v153: removed icon glyphs from calendar filter chips and notification settings; moved notification alert settings into expandable Profile Settings; updated Mobile UI Designer preview parity.

v158 profile JSON: Settings accordion appears after profile action buttons; notification alert settings live inside Settings; assigned scope, role and company appear below Settings; logout preview hidden; buttons use same accent family.
v164: Home embedded metrics stay as the old horizontal strip. Projects and Tasks pages use the new responsive stats grid with 1/2/3/4-column breakpoints and safe compact-phone sizing.
v165: Normalized floating top-nav initial content padding from duplicated 112 + 22 protection to a single 96px protection so Dashboard/Projects/Tasks titles do not sit too far below the top dock.
v166: Reduced floating top-nav initial content protection to 82px while keeping extra protection at 0 to bring Dashboard/Projects/Tasks titles closer to the dock without overlap.
v167: APK shell and Mobile UI Designer now respect explicit Firestore top padding (82) instead of overriding it with runtimeSafe max padding on tall Android phones.
v168: Projects and Tasks pages render page search before filters and stats. The order is controlled by JSON placement/order keys, not hardcoded screen order.
v168: Explicit Firestore top padding remains 82 and wins over runtime padding; renderer fallback is used only when JSON omits a value.
v169: New mobile login/sign-up UI is scoped to Android/iOS APK only. Flutter Web keeps the stable legacy web auth screen; renderer blocks server-driven auth on web runtime unless previewMode is true.
v170: Non-Home Projects/Tasks pages use JSON-controlled order: search bar -> summary stats -> filters/tabs -> content. Home keeps its own published section order.
v171: Renderer is reduced to a JSON-first primitive/action engine. Screen order uses sectionOrder/contentOrder/pageOrder from JSON; auth method visibility and labels use authUiPolicy.
v171: Added AuthService API actions for email login, signup, password reset, provider sign-in and logout; web still uses legacy auth.

v172: Adds JSON-controlled brute-force protection for login, signup, and password reset with Cloud Functions rate-limit checks, local fallback lockout, hashed attempt storage, and generic auth error messages.
v173: Renderer is more JSON-first and safe. Unknown widgets no longer block the screen by default; they render as safe cards/columns or hide based on rendererSafety.unsupportedWidgetMode.
v173: Summary/stat cards can now be ordered, renamed, hidden, recolored, and icon-swapped through JSON summaryStats/stats/metricCards without renderer changes.
v173: Generic column/row/grid primitives now honor JSON visible/enabled, padding, margin, gap/spacing, responsive columns, and overflow-safe wrapping.
v174: Restores old visual defaults after v173. JSON controls remain available, but visual/layout primitive changes are opt-in so existing UI stays like older versions.

changes: Renderer safety policy controls unsupported/unknown widget behavior from JSON.
Per-node recovery prevents one bad JSON child from blanking the whole screen.
Generic Column/Row/Grid honor JSON visibility, padding, margin, gap, responsive columns and wrap behavior.
Project/Task summary stats are JSON-controlled through summaryStats/stats/metricCards.
Unsupported banner is hidden by default; Admin can enable it with rendererSafety.showUnsupportedBanner.
releaseNotes.v172: Adds login/sign-up brute-force protection using checkAuthRateLimit and recordAuthAttempt callable functions plus JSON-controlled policy.
releaseNotes.v173: Adds JSON-first safe controls so unsupported child widgets, summary stats, responsive grid layout, visibility, spacing, padding, and primitive ordering can be changed from JSON without breaking rendering.
releaseNotes.v174: Restores old visual compatibility: row/grid/unsupported-widget behavior defaults match older renderer, while JSON-first controls remain opt-in.
